properties.name: kev.auth.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens.

properties.name: kev.auth.google.client-ids
properties.description: List of accepted Google OAuth client IDs.

properties.name: kev.auth.apple.client-ids
properties.description: List of accepted Apple client IDs.

properties.name: kev.ml.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the ML FastAPI service.

properties.name: kev.ml.read-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Read timeout for ML calls. A batch embed is far slower than a single scan, so too low a value reports a healthy service as unavailable.

properties.name: kev.uits.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the external UITS student system.

properties.name: kev.face.match-threshold
properties.description: Minimum cosine similarity for a 1:N face match to be accepted.

properties.name: kev.face.margin-threshold
properties.description: Minimum lead the top match must have over the runner-up.

properties.name: kev.face.min-det-score
properties.description: Minimum detector confidence before a capture is matched at all.

properties.name: kev.face.ingest-concurrency
properties.description: Concurrent reference-photo fetches during roster embedding.

properties.name: kev.face.embed-batch-size
properties.description: Students per ML call and per DB commit during roster embedding.
